description: The chill room: breath-fogging cold, racks of shrouded pallets furred with frost, and a floor slick enough to teach you humility. Something hangs on the far hooks under a tarp; the tag, when you can read it through the ice, just says HOLD.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
